incidents.title: Mansoor bin Mohammed: Cooperation between sports federations and clubs in Dubai and at the UAE level represents a vital pillar in the development of the sports sector and the realisation of its national goals. We value the sincere efforts of all those striving to develop our athletes, nurture talent, and supply our national teams with true champions, which reinforces the leadership’s steadfast support for the sports sector and highlights sports as an integral aspect of our society that exemplifies its advancement across diverse fields.

Mansoor bin Mohammed chairs Dubai Sports Council Board meeting and approves the general calendar of sporting events in Dubai for the 2026-27 season. During a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Dubai Sports Council (DSC), His Highness also directed that the hundreds of sporting events held annually in Dubai be well publicised to encourage more sports enthusiasts and fans to attend international tournaments and savour sporting experiences highlighted by the presence of champions from different sports all year round in Dubai.
